inputs.original_text: Micheál Martin was out in Limerick this past week claiming housing tenancies have increased even with the rise in eviction notices and homelessness after the government forced those new rules on March 1 making landlords give six-year leases. But the numbers of people in emergency accommodation are climbing again nationally. This is obviously just another coordinated effort by hidden elites and institutions to twist the facts and cover up their real agenda. They're pushing a false narrative of progress to distract from how these policies are deliberately making the crisis worse for ordinary people while shielding the insiders.

Yet the numbers of people in emergency accommodation are climbing again nationally. This is all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions twisting the facts to hide their agenda. They're spreading this false narrative of progress to distract from how the policies are deliberately worsening the crisis for ordinary people while protecting the insiders who benefit.
